"""Maximum single-definition sizes: 16 fields, 4096-element arrays, 4096 enums."""
import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit

fields = [["f%02d" % i, "I8"] for i in range(16)]
types = [{"name": "I8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
         {"name": "S16", "kind": "struct", "fields": fields},
         {"name": "A4096", "kind": "array", "element": "S16", "size": 1},
         {"name": "BIG", "kind": "array", "element": "I8", "size": 4096},
         {"name": "E", "kind": "enum", "values": ["e%d" % i for i in range(4096)]},
         {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
modules = [{"name": "m", "params": [["a", "A4096"], ["b", "BIG"], ["e", "E"]],
            "result": ["r", "B"],
            "requires": ["eq", ["index", ["field", ["index", ["var", "a"], 0], "f00"],
                         ["const", "I8", 3]]}]
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
start = time.time()
_, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print("compile %.2fs variables %d slots %d" % (time.time() - start, plan["variables"],
                                               len(plan["slots"])))
assert plan["variables"] == 1 + 1 + 16 + 1 + 4096 + 1 + 1   # A4096 id, struct id, 16, BIG id, 4096, enum, result
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in
     zip(plan["slots"], [3] + list(range(15)) + list(range(4096)) + [4095])])}
    for _ in range(3)]
start = time.time()
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print("runs %.2fs %s" % (time.time() - start, out["records"]))
assert [r["status"] for r in out["records"]] == ["READY", "DUPLICATE", "DUPLICATE"]
assert out["corpus"][0]["inputs"]["a"][0]["f00"] == 3
assert out["corpus"][0]["inputs"]["e"] == "e4095"
assert len(out["corpus"][0]["inputs"]["b"]) == 4096
print("MAXTYPES OK")
PYEOF
python3 t_maxtypes.py
